The controller gives general written authorisation for the use of subprocessors.
The processor shall inform the controller of any intended change of subprocessor.
The processor remains fully liable for the acts and omissions of its subprocessors.

Personal data shall not be transferred outside the European Economic Area.
Transfers outside the European Economic Area require appropriate safeguards.
The processor shall keep a record of all international transfers.
